references.text: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad come to Moses and the leaders of Israel, the same tribal group as in Joshua 22:21
Moses gave land to the children of Reuben, the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh - the same tribes that respond in Joshua 22:21
Describes the land distribution to Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh on the east side of the Jordan
Joshua reminds Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh of their obligation to help the other tribes
The context for the conflict - the eastern tribes built an altar by the Jordan
The leaders of Israel hear the response from the tribes and are satisfied with the explanation
Reference to 'chiefs over thousands' - the same leadership structure as 'heads of the thousands of Israel'
